%NAME%
lanleecher-agent

%BASE%
lanleecher-agent

%VERSION%
1.4.1-1

%DESC%
Host agent for LANLeecher. Reports the traffic per MAC address of a Linux host and of the guests of a Proxmox VE node, so that LANLeecher can split switch ports with several MAC addresses (hypervisors) between them.
